# Schema

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `date` | ISO-8601 date | First observation of the month |
| `rate` | number | Target for the overnight rate, per cent |

The full daily series has about 1,470 rows; this keeps the first
observation of each month to stay small enough to commit. The same
upstream series feeds the `overnight` table in
[the mortgage rates dataset](/references/data/rates.md), which records
every change by effective date rather than a monthly sample.
